g.text: Cu-calibrated offsets transferred to the oxides
Black: experiment. Colors: calculations. Traces scaled to unit maximum. Blank cells: missing data or insufficient overlap.
*“GW” is an unverified directory label. Dashed CuO FDM: single site; incomplete final-state processing.
